subproblem.title: From cube-wise pointwise bounds to the Lipschitz constant c/σ on {dist(·, L) ≥ σ}
subproblem.statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and c₁ ≥ 0. There is c ∈ [0,∞), depending only on N and c₁, such that for every set L ⊆ ℝ^N = Eucl N and every map ψ : ℝ^N → ℝ^N satisfying (H1) for every z ∈ ℤ^N and x ∉ L with z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i, also z_i ≤ ψ(x)_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i, and (H2) for every z ∈ ℤ^N, every x ∉ L with z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i and every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 with |ψ(x′) − ψ(x)| ≤ (c₁/dist(x, L) + ε)|x′ − x| for all x′ ∉ L with z_i ≤ x′_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i and |x′ − x| < δ, the following holds: for every σ with 0 < σ ≤ 1/4, ψ is Lipschitz with constant c/σ on {x : dist(x, L) ≥ σ} (dist(x, L) = infDist x L, which is 0 when L = ∅; as in Lean, c₁/0 is read as 0 in (H2), a case never used in the proof).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (c₁ : ℝ), 0 ≤ c₁ → ∃ c : ℝ≥0, ∀ (L : Set (Eucl N)) (ψ : Eucl N → Eucl N), (∀ (z : Fin N → ℤ) (x : Eucl N), x ∉ L → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ ψ x i ∧ ψ x i ≤ z i + 1) → (∀ (z : Fin N → ℤ) (x : Eucl N), x ∉ L → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl N, x' ∉ L → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ z i + 1) → dist x' x < δ → dist (ψ x') (ψ x) ≤ (c₁ / infDist x L + ε) * dist x' x) → ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ 1 / 4 → LipschitzOnWith (c / Real.toNNReal σ) ψ {x | σ ≤ infDist x L}
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: Step 6 of the parent proof (the last sentence of the parent's B3), with Step 5 supplied by the sibling lemma deformation_retraction_dini_segment. In Step 6(a) the parent's explicit subdivision 0 = s₀ < ⋯ < s_r = 1 of the segment into pieces lying in single unit cubes is replaced by the equivalent local observation 5(b) below (each parameter has a right and a left neighbourhood whose points lie in one closed unit cube together with it), which lets Step 5 be applied once to the whole segment; the constants are those of Step 6.

0. Notation. Q := [0,1]^N; for z ∈ ℤ^N, x ∈ z + Q means z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i; ⌊x⌋ := (⌊x_i⌋)_i, so x ∈ ⌊x⌋ + Q. dist(x, L) := infDist x L; it is 1-Lipschitz in x (Metric.infDist_le_infDist_add_dist), and dist(w, L) = 0 for w ∈ L (Metric.infDist_zero_of_mem).
1. The constant. c := max{2c₁, 1/4 + 4√N} ≥ 0 (as an element of ℝ≥0); it depends only on N and c₁, and is chosen before L and ψ. Fix L, ψ satisfying (H1), (H2), fix σ with 0 < σ ≤ 1/4 and put A := {x : σ ≤ dist(x, L)}. Since σ > 0, the real number underlying c / Real.toNNReal σ is c/σ, so it suffices (LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul) to prove |ψ(x) − ψ(x′)| ≤ (c/σ)|x − x′| for all x, x′ ∈ A.
2. A point w with dist(w, L) > 0 is not in L. In particular A ∩ L = ∅.
3. Displacement. For y ∉ L, |ψ(y) − y| ≤ √N: with z := ⌊y⌋ we have y ∈ z + Q, so ψ(y) ∈ z + Q by (H1); hence |ψ(y)_i − y_i| ≤ 1 for each i and |ψ(y) − y|² ≤ N.
4. Far pairs: x, x′ ∈ A with |x − x′| ≥ σ/2. By 2, 3 and the triangle inequality, |ψ(x) − ψ(x′)| ≤ |ψ(x) − x| + |x − x′| + |x′ − ψ(x′)| ≤ |x − x′| + 2√N. Since σ ≤ 1/4, |x − x′| ≤ (1/(4σ))|x − x′|; since |x − x′| ≥ σ/2, 2√N ≤ (4√N/σ)|x − x′|. Hence |ψ(x) − ψ(x′)| ≤ ((1/4 + 4√N)/σ)|x − x′| ≤ (c/σ)|x − x′|.
5. Near pairs: x, x′ ∈ A with |x − x′| < σ/2. Put v := x′ − x, p_s := x + s·v and γ(s) := ψ(p_s) (s ∈ ℝ). If v = 0 there is nothing to prove, so let v ≠ 0.
 (a) For s ∈ [0,1], dist(p_s, L) ≥ dist(x, L) − |p_s − x| ≥ σ − s|v| > σ/2 > 0. Hence p_s ∉ L by 2, and c₁/dist(p_s, L) ≤ 2c₁/σ (c₁ ≥ 0).
 (b) One-sided cubes. Fix s ∈ [0,1] and p := p_s. Define z⁺, z⁻ ∈ ℤ^N by z⁺_i := ⌊p_i⌋ if v_i ≥ 0, z⁺_i := ⌈p_i⌉ − 1 if v_i < 0, and z⁻_i := ⌊p_i⌋ if v_i ≤ 0, z⁻_i := ⌈p_i⌉ − 1 if v_i > 0. Then p ∈ z⁺ + Q, p ∈ z⁻ + Q, and there is τ₀ > 0 such that p_{s′} ∈ z⁺ + Q for s ≤ s′ < s + τ₀ and p_{s′} ∈ z⁻ + Q for s − τ₀ < s′ ≤ s. Proof, coordinatewise for z⁺ and s′ ≥ s (the case of z⁻ and s′ ≤ s is the same with v replaced by −v): (p_{s′})_i = p_i + (s′ − s)v_i. If v_i ≥ 0, then (p_{s′})_i ≥ p_i ≥ ⌊p_i⌋, and since p_i < ⌊p_i⌋ + 1, (p_{s′})_i ≤ ⌊p_i⌋ + 1 whenever (s′ − s)v_i ≤ ⌊p_i⌋ + 1 − p_i (a positive number). If v_i < 0, then (p_{s′})_i ≤ p_i ≤ ⌈p_i⌉ = z⁺_i + 1, and since p_i > ⌈p_i⌉ − 1, (p_{s′})_i ≥ ⌈p_i⌉ − 1 whenever (s′ − s)|v_i| ≤ p_i − ⌈p_i⌉ + 1 (a positive number). Take τ₀ as the minimum of the finitely many positive radii obtained (τ₀ := 1 if v_i = 0 for all i).
 (c) Pointwise hypothesis of dini_segment for γ with K := (2c₁/σ)|v|. Let s ∈ [0,1], ε > 0, p := p_s, ε′ := ε/|v|. By (H2) at p (p ∉ L by (a)) for the cube z⁺ and for the cube z⁻ with ε′, there are δ₊, δ₋ > 0. Put δ := min{τ₀, δ₊/|v|, δ₋/|v|}. Let s′ ∈ [0,1] with |s′ − s| < δ; let ς := + if s′ ≥ s and ς := − otherwise. Then p_{s′} ∈ z^ς + Q by (b), p_{s′} ∉ L by (a), and |p_{s′} − p| = |s′ − s||v| < δ_ς, so (H2) gives |γ(s′) − γ(s)| ≤ (c₁/dist(p, L) + ε′)|s′ − s||v| ≤ ((2c₁/σ)|v| + ε)|s′ − s|, using (a).
 (d) By deformation_retraction_dini_segment (with N, γ and K := (2c₁/σ)|v|), |ψ(x′) − ψ(x)| = |γ(1) − γ(0)| ≤ (2c₁/σ)|v| = (2c₁/σ)|x − x′| ≤ (c/σ)|x − x′|.
6. By 4 and 5, |ψ(x) − ψ(x′)| ≤ (c/σ)|x − x′| for all x, x′ ∈ A, i.e. ψ is Lipschitz with constant c / Real.toNNReal σ on {x : σ ≤ infDist x L}. (If L = ∅ then infDist x L = 0 and A = ∅, so the claim is trivial; the argument above does not need this case distinction.) ∎
proof_key_steps: c := max{2c₁, 1/4 + 4√N}; reduce LipschitzOnWith to a distance inequality on A = {dist(·, L) ≥ σ}.
Displacement |ψ(y) − y| ≤ √N for y ∉ L, from (H1) with z = ⌊y⌋.
Far pairs (|x − x′| ≥ σ/2): triangle inequality and σ ≤ 1/4.
Near pairs: the segment stays in {dist(·, L) > σ/2}; one-sided neighbourhoods of each parameter lie in single unit cubes z⁺ + Q, z⁻ + Q; (H2) gives the pointwise hypothesis with K = (2c₁/σ)|x′ − x|.

audit.reason: The prose and type agree for arbitrary N and L. Cube preservation supplies the displacement estimate for far pairs; for near pairs, the segment stays at positive distance from L and the explicit one-sided cubes yield the exact dini_segment hypothesis. Zero displacement is handled, c₁≥0 is used correctly, and positive σ justifies the NNReal division conversion. The constant is chosen before L and ψ. Its only sibling reliance is the declared dini_segment dependency, and no closedness or nonemptiness assumption on L is missing.
